full_prompt_en: A square symbolic oil painting brings a tightly packed row of people into close left-facing profile. A young woman near the right center is the clearest figure. Dark wavy hair frames her pale face beneath a broad white headscarf that folds over the back of her head. Her long neck rises from a dark garment scattered with muted gold and cream floral marks, with a narrow pale collar at the throat. Just behind her stands a fair-haired young woman in a rich red patterned dress. Farther left, other profiles diminish in scale and clarity, including a figure in a dark green cap. At the far right, part of an older face enters the frame, its lines and warmer skin tone contrasting with the smooth central face. Nearly every visible gaze points left. The people stand so close that shoulders, hair and garments overlap, producing a continuous horizontal rhythm of noses and cheeks. The background is a dense, worn field of pale stone, green foliage and scattered gold patches rather than a clearly separated setting. Skin is rendered with smooth, careful modeling, while clothing and ground carry rougher, flecked pigment. Light is soft and frontal, lifting the pale faces and headscarf while leaving small shadows beneath brows, noses and folds. The palette is restrained cream, olive, charcoal and ochre, punctuated by a strong area of deep red. No single person moves; the arrangement feels like a solemn procession held in place. The whole composition compresses depth into a narrow band, using repeated profiles and contrasting textures to create a contemplative, patterned image.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形象征性油画把一列紧密相接的人物带到近处，他们都以向左的侧脸入画。靠右中央的年轻女子最清晰。深色波浪发框住浅白面孔，宽阔白头巾盖住脑后并形成褶皱。她细长的颈部从散布低饱和金色和奶油色花纹的深衣服中升起，喉部有一圈窄浅领口。她后面是一位浅发年轻女子，穿浓红色花纹衣裙。更左边，其他侧脸在尺度和清晰度上逐渐减弱，其中一人戴深绿帽。最右边，一张年长面孔的一部分进入画面，其皱纹和较暖肤色与中央平滑的脸相对。几乎所有可见目光都指向左。人物站得很近，肩、头发和衣服相互重叠，形成鼻梁与脸颊连续的横向节奏。背景是一片浅石色、绿叶与散落金色斑块组成的密集磨旧色域，而非明确分开的场景。皮肤经过平顺、细致的塑形，衣料和背景则保留更粗糙的颜料碎点。柔光从正面照来，抬亮浅色面孔和白头巾，在眉、鼻和衣褶下留下小阴影。调色以克制的奶油色、橄榄绿、炭黑和赭色为主，一块深红显著突出。没有人物动作；这列形体像被凝住的庄严队伍。整个构图把纵深压进狭窄色带，以反复侧影和肌理对照形成沉思而有图案感的图像。
style_prompt_en: The image has a finely modeled oil-painted surface that contrasts smooth pale passages with densely flecked, weathered pigment. Cream, olive, dark green and old gold make a muted field, interrupted by one strong red area. Repeated curved contours form a horizontal cadence, and closely overlapping shapes compress depth almost to a decorative plane. Edges around light forms are precise but soft, while darker patterned areas merge irregularly into the ground. Diffuse frontal light gives gentle volume without a strong cast shadow. Fine facial gradations sit beside rougher textile and mineral-looking marks, keeping attention on differences of material treatment. Near forms are clear; more distant ones become progressively smaller and less distinct through overlap rather than strong perspective. The composition feels solemn and still, with balanced variation inside a repeated sequence. A narrow range of aged color and gold flecks gives the image a rich but restrained surface.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有细致塑形的油画表面，平滑浅色段落与密集碎点、风化颜料形成对照。奶油色、橄榄色、深绿和旧金色构成低饱和色域，被一块强烈红色打断。反复的曲线轮廓形成横向节拍，紧密重叠的形状把纵深压到近乎装饰平面。浅色形体周围的边缘准确却柔软，较暗的纹饰区则不规则地融入背景。漫射正面光赋予轻微体积，不形成强烈投影。细腻的面部渐变紧邻更粗糙的织物和近似矿物的笔痕，让不同材质处理成为焦点。近处形体清楚；远处主要通过遮挡逐渐变小、变模糊，而非强透视。构图庄重静止，在反复序列内部保持有度变化。狭窄的古旧色域与金色碎点使表面丰富而克制。
theme_en: A close row of solemn profiles gathers around a young woman in a white headscarf and patterned dress
theme_zh: 一列庄重的侧脸紧密排列，围绕一位戴白头巾、穿花纹衣裙的年轻女子
name: Edgar Maxence
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
